messages:
Elaine Park: FYI — Voss Industries (acct voss-456) says procurement will not accept an invoice until they get an official PO. They've attached a signed SOW but procurement insists on a PO number and VAT breakdown. Holding billing for now. Can finance/sales pick up? :white_flag:

Javier Mendez: thanks Elaine. Do we have the exact PO template they require? I asked them to send procurement contact. They said PO must reference 'Redwood Dedicated SLA' and include our tax ID.

Maya Singh: tagging finance. We can't issue invoice without a PO? Our billing system has a flag for 'require_po' on the customer profile. For voss-456 it's set to true. I can flip it if legal signs off, but need audit trail (email from procurement) before disabling.

Elaine Park: procurement sent two docs: signed-sow.pdf and procurement-policy.pdf. They say they need invoice to include VAT line as separate amount (they're EU entity). Also they want SLA clause included in order reference.

Dan Hu: technical note — nothing in the billing pipeline is failing; the create-invoice job returns 422 when require_po is true and no po_number is provided. Error in logs: `BillingError: missing_po_number (acct=voss-456)`

Elaine Park: copy of their email pasted below: "Procurement will only release funds upon receipt of a formal PO referencing the SOW and our tax info. We will not accept pro forma invoices."

Javier Mendez: proposal — Sales to request a procurement-signed PO (PDF with PO number) and confirm VAT number. If they refuse, offer to add 'PO to follow' note but legal warns against issuing invoice without PO for enterprise accounts.

Maya Singh: steps from finance side: 1) get PO PDF or confirmation email from procurement email domain (procurement@voss.com) 2) match PO to account and update billing.profile.po_number 3) run manual invoice job `bin/invoice --account voss-456 --manual` 4) attach VAT breakdown line and keep audit log.

Elaine Park: customer wants billing today. Can Sales escalate to their procurement lead with a template we can populate? Javier — can you send a templated PO request?

Javier Mendez: I'll send a templated PO request and cc finance. Template will include required fields: PO number, billing address, VAT ID, reference to SOW id #SOW-2025-78, and billing contact. I'll ping when sent.

InvoiceBot: automated note — invoice creation blocked: reason=missing_po_number, account=voss-456, job_id=inv-20250021. See /billing/logs/inv-20250021 for details.

Maya Singh: once we receive PO, I can generate invoice same day. If procurement delays, we should document refusal and offer proforma as an interim but only with Legal approval.

Elaine Park: adding action items: - Javier to send PO template to customer (ETA 2h) - Customer to return signed PO (ETA unknown) - Maya to standby to run manual invoice job on receipt - Dan to attach error log to ticket.

Dan Hu: attached error snippet for SRE/finance: ```
2025-09-12T14:03:01Z ERROR BillingService create-invoice failed account=voss-456 err=missing_po_number
2025-09-12T14:03:01Z INFO invoice job inv-20250021 queued by support/elaine
```

Javier Mendez: sent PO template to procurement@voss.com and cc'd maya@redwood.com. Waiting on reply. :sent: 

Elaine Park: marking this thread high priority. Please update here when PO received or if procurement escalates additional requirements. :eyes:
